Name: Adonijah, Son of David
Summary: Fourth son of David, born in Hebron to Haggith.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:2: Fourth son of David, born in Hebron to Haggith.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Adonijah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
